narr: A band of slow moving showers and thunderstorms producing heavy rain along a slow moving cold front and produced flash flooding across Wake County in central North Carolina.
ev: Flash flooding was reported in the 2300 block of Atlantic Avenue, where a water rescue occurred.
Flash flooding closed multiple westbound lanes of Interstate 440.
